references.text: The children of Israel did all that the Lord had commanded Moses, a parallel formulation about obedience to God's commands through Moses.
The children of Israel did all the work just as the Lord had commanded Moses; this same formula of obedience is used here regarding the construction of the tabernacle.
Describes how the children of Israel broke camp according to their divisions, a direct fulfillment of the instructions to travel by their banners.
Balaam saw Israel encamped tribe by tribe, confirming that they followed the camp arrangement according to their families.
Moses spoke to the children of Israel all that the Lord had commanded him, showing the consistent pattern of obedience to the Lord's commands.
Moses did everything just as the Lord had commanded him; this same formula of obedience confirms faithful adherence to God's instructions.
